en: Kilesasampayuttaduka (The Pair on Factors Associated with Defilements)
Dependent on a state associated with the defilements (*kilesa*), a state not associated with the defilements arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state dissociated from the defilements, a state dissociated from the defilements arises by way of the root condition … three [cases].
Dependent on a state both associated with and dissociated from the defilements, a state associated with the defilements arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five. (The full detail for all [conditions] is as follows.)
